status: Declared under the operator's decisions OD-3 and OD-4 and the research divergence records, cited per entry.

divergences.resend: Verifies the key; an invalid or deleted key answers validation_error 'API key is invalid', 401 on POST /emails and 400 on reads
divergences.app_emulator: Accepts any non-empty Bearer token; a missing key answers 401 missing_api_key. A token the emulator issued through POST /api-keys is honoured, so a sending_access key answers 401 restricted_api_key on anything but a send
divergences.reason: The app emulator knows only the keys it issued, so it has no account keys to check other tokens against

divergences.resend: Refuses any sender domain that is not verified on the team with 403 validation_error
divergences.app_emulator: By default refuses only a domain created through POST /domains and not yet verified; a domain it has never seen is accepted. strict_sender_domains in /admin/config refuses every domain that is not created and verified
divergences.reason: Tests run with no domain setup by default; strict mode is there for clients that need Resend's refusal

divergences.resend: The shared sender may send to the account owner's address and to resend.dev test addresses
divergences.app_emulator: In strict mode the shared sender may send to resend.dev test addresses only, with Resend's 403 'You can only send testing emails to your own email address' for any other recipient
divergences.reason: The app emulator has no account owner

divergences.resend: Enforces the team's rate limit and answers 429 rate_limit_exceeded
divergences.app_emulator: Off by default: sends Resend's headers with fixed values (ratelimit-limit 10, ratelimit-policy 10;w=1, ratelimit-remaining 9, ratelimit-reset 1) and never answers 429. rate_limit in /admin/config sets a limit per one-second window of emulator-clock time across all keys, past which it answers 429 rate_limit_exceeded with retry-after
divergences.reason: A test should not fail on throttling it did not ask for; one that tests its backoff turns the limit on

divergences.resend: Counts sends against daily and monthly quotas, reports them in x-resend-daily-quota and x-resend-monthly-quota, and answers 429 when one is exceeded
divergences.app_emulator: Keeps no quota and sends neither header
divergences.reason: Quotas belong to a Resend plan, which the app emulator does not have

divergences.resend: Accepts ISO 8601 or natural language, such as 'in 1 hour', 'tomorrow at 9am' or 'Friday at 3pm ET'
divergences.app_emulator: Accepts ISO 8601 and the relative form 'in N min|hour|day'; other natural language answers 422 validation_error with Resend's unparsable-date message
divergences.reason: Resend documents examples, not a grammar, for absolute natural-language times; the relative form covers the documented SDK examples and is deterministic against the store clock

divergences.resend: Not recorded for a batch. A single send from the key's own unverified domain answers 400 with message and statusCode and no name; the key may still send from onboarding@resend.dev
divergences.app_emulator: Refuses the whole batch with the single-send 400 when any item is from the key's own unverified domain
divergences.reason: Only the single-send answer was recorded; the batch reuses it rather than inventing a per-item error

divergences.resend: Starts an asynchronous DNS check; the domain is pending, then verified, failed or partially_verified
divergences.app_emulator: Settles at once on verified, or on pending or failed when domain_verification in /admin/config says so; partially_verified is not produced
divergences.reason: The emulator checks no DNS; tests choose the outcome they need

divergences.resend: The OpenAPI documents only top-level /contacts, but resend-go and resend-node call the audience-scoped paths
divergences.app_emulator: Serves the audience-scoped paths the SDKs call; top-level /contacts is not served
divergences.reason: The SDKs are the more accurate description of what Resend serves

divergences.app_emulator: Clears all state and restores the seed; needs no API key
Returns all state as JSON; needs no API key
Replaces all state from JSON; needs no API key
Injects a fault on an endpoint; needs no API key
Removes an injected fault; needs no API key
Lists injected faults; needs no API key
Returns the request log; needs no API key
Flushes queued webhooks; needs no API key
Advances the emulator clock; needs no API key
Returns the emulator clock; needs no API key
Readiness check; needs no API key
Returns runtime config, including strict_sender_domains, domain_verification and rate_limit; needs no API key
Updates runtime config; needs no API key
Lists quirks; needs no API key
Enables a quirk; needs no API key
Disables a quirk; needs no API key
Lists sent emails as stored, including fields a read does not return; needs no API key

divergences.resend: Refuses an http endpoint with 422 validation_error 'Endpoint URL scheme must be https'
divergences.app_emulator: Accepts http and https endpoints; refuses any other scheme with Resend's message
divergences.reason: Receivers in local development and CI run on plain http; requiring TLS would stop the emulator delivering to them
divergences.decision: resend-bp2 s08, research/twins/resend/build-plans/resend-bp2.json; observed in run 2026-11-08 (probe o08)
